# Capraly

> AI-powered code editor that reviews code line-by-line, flags real bugs, and suggests fixes — all in the browser.

Capraly is a modern web-based code editor built on Monaco (the engine behind VS Code) and Lovable Cloud. It pairs a full-featured editor (file tree, tabs, terminal) with AI tools: a bug finder, an inline ⌘K rewrite, a pair-programming chat, and a multi-file composer. Code runs in a sandboxed edge runtime (JS/TS via Deno, Python via Pyodide). Projects export as ZIPs and deploy via Netlify/Vercel drop.
